newsitem.title: UK: Algeria seeks higher prices for November crude.
newsitem.headline: Algeria seeks higher prices for November crude.

text.p: Algeria is seeking a 10-20 cent increase for its benchmark Saharan Blend crude in current negotiations with term lifters for November with buyers hoping for a rollover, traders familiar with the talks said.
Algeria raised prices 10 cents a barrel last month to take advantage of strong demand for sweet crudes in the Mediterranean region. It now wants to raise November prices to Dated Brent +80/+90 cents.
"Last month was a different market because naphtha was stronger. Buyers want a rollover," a trader for an oil major said. -- London newsroom +44 171 542 4088
